Building: San Francisco Ferry Building, San Francisco (ferry terminal).
The front (−z) is the Embarcadero front at the foot of Market Street.
Footprint: 201.4 m along x by 56.1 m along z, centred on the origin.
Outline (approximate: the hull of its OpenStreetMap parts), [x, z] in metres, going round:
[[-100.7,-19.2],[-22.4,-28.1],[20.9,-28.1],[100.7,-19.2],[100.7,28.1],[-100.7,28.1]]
Height: the highest point is 75 m above the ground.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. elevated view of the whole long arcaded building with its central clock tower, palms in the plaza, bay behind, daylight
  2. aerial three-quarter from the north showing the tower and the long roof of the shed, pier side and street, daylight
  3. high oblique aerial over the piers: the tower and long building with plaza and the bay-side piers

Reply with the JSON object only.
